ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, there are three horizontal straight lines labeled l1, l2, l3, and they are parallel to each other; two oblique lines a, b respectively intersect these three parallel lines. The intersection points of oblique line a with l1, l2, l3 in order are A, B, C; the intersection points of oblique line b with l1, l2, l3 in order are D, E, F. It is known that AB/BC = 2/3, and DE = 4. According to the theorem that parallel lines divide line segments proportionally, the corresponding line segments intercepted by two transversals between the same two sets of parallel lines are proportional, so AB/BC = DE/EF. Substituting the data gives 2/3 = 4/EF, cross-multiplying: 2EF = 12, therefore EF = 6.

Substitute the text data AB/BC = 2/3 and DE = 4, giving 2/3 = 4/EF, hence EF = 6.
